subject.title: fix(worker): keep artifact reads private by default

question: Should brokered artifact reads become signed by default when `CRABBOX_ARTIFACTS_BASE_URL` is configured, with `CRABBOX_ARTIFACTS_PUBLIC_READS=1` as the compatibility opt-in for public non-expiring links?
rationale: This is a security-boundary improvement that intentionally changes existing base-URL behavior for operators, so automation cannot choose the permanent default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt default-private reads
options.body: Accept the compatibility migration, require real R2 proof and docs alignment, then merge this policy direction.

options.title: Preserve public-read default
options.body: Keep existing base-URL behavior and instead add an explicit strict/private mode, accepting the weaker default boundary for compatibility.

options.title: Pause for a narrower policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define a different signed/proxied read contract or public publishing contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt default-private reads
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility migration, require real R2 proof and docs alignment, then merge this policy direction.

likelyOwner.reason: The current artifact broker and adjacent Worker history point to steipete as the strongest available owner for the compatibility/security policy choice.
